Class PlanetAstroSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.planet.PlanetAstroSectionBuilder
public class PlanetAstroSectionBuilder extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller and Section Builder for Astronomy, Physical Characteristics, Orbital Dynamics, and Celestial Body Configurations (Planets and Natural Satellites).

Extracted from PlanetGeneratorPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Calculates solar irradiance, stellar equilibrium blackbody temperatures, and greenhouse thermal forcings.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
